q: Can a factory in Vietnam lower its market based Scope 2 through a direct power purchase agreement?
title: Vietnam direct PPA: Scope 2 effect
short: Yes, if the contract carries the renewable attributes to your site. A 2024 decree allows direct power purchase from wind and solar producers, through a private line or through the national grid. Market based Scope 2 can count those kWh at zero with the contract and monthly delivery records; location based stays on the grid factor.
audience: Large electronics, footwear, garment and furniture factories in Binh Duong, Dong Nai and northern industrial parks

ul: Private line: the producer connects directly to your plant.
Through the grid: you buy from the producer via the utility, with settlement rules.
Contract naming your site and the attributes.
Monthly delivered kWh matched to consumption.
No double sale of certificates for the same power.

p: Consumption thresholds, voltage levels and fees are set in the rules and can change. Confirm with the current decree and your industrial park operator.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills and supply statements into a dated, fingerprinted record, so the kWh behind a market based claim trace back to the documents.
